name: hud_sensor_tracker_write_mission_data_section
description: HudSensorTracker::WriteMissionDataSection serializes the current HUD mission state into the MissionData ZAR section. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x417430 show construction of a 0x5c-byte MissionData stack record from mission fields, ten objective completed flags, zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode, and zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob(writer, "MissionData", &missionData, 0x5c).
Direct callees zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode and zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob are dependency-ready and functional-equivalent/provider-accepted for this use.

The native mission-data smoke writes through a real zZbdManager section callback into a temporary file and verifies the section path, payload size, all serialized fields, ten completed flags, and difficulty mode.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x417430 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
